rule_or_requirement: Only pixel observations and prior runtime state may steer a submission candidate; local completion must not regress while lap time improves.
observable_information: The last consecutive visible near-road-center change in the four-frame pixel stack, current road visibility and inherited pixel-driver action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: For at most six low-visibility decisions, replace inherited steer by +/-0.7 in the observed road-motion direction; retain gas and brake.
expected_success_endpoint: On three consumed TRAIN seed-5176 cells, at least two cells change actions, no valid control finish is lost, one cell shortens its longest low-visibility streak and none lengthens by more than ten decisions, with zero invalid actions.
control: Unchanged exact bend-rebound ZIP SHA-256 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49 represented by its frozen behaviorally identical source controller.
falsifier: No actual action changes in two cells, lost control finish, no shorter low-visibility interval, >10-decision worsening or invalid action.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Paired source-controller episodes on consumed TRAIN 1:5176, 2:5176, 3:5176; six episodes, not submission-candidate rate evidence.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered Linux CPU local diagnostic capped at 900 seconds, two cores, 2 GiB and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
